The briefing says only that Rook came home alone."},{"span":"Her steady gaze locked onto the enemy","reason":"Implies Dunmore is present, but the briefing says he escaped."}],"voice":3,"clarity":2,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The scene contradicts the briefing: Rook came home alone, yet Elske kneels at the body.
